findings.title: Cross-flow CF-004: price adjustment + refund completion + cancel may triple-stack payouts (30 + 100 + 100 = 230 > 100)

evidence.summary: The most aggressive cross-flow composed sequence: all three payout actions from all three recorded sources are composed on the same order — price adjustment (source 'price', $30), refund request + refund completion (source 'refund', $100), and cancel (source 'cancel', $100). Each UI removes its respective affordance after its action, but the server may not enforce the pairwise locks when actions from different recorded flows are composed. If all three payouts succeed, totalReturned = 30 + 100 + 100 = 230, more than double the original $100 payment.
